Widget family: TEXT INPUT

Strict visual criteria (PASS only if ALL hold for the claimed state):

1. A rectangular field with a clear border or recessed face is visible (input chrome, not a bare label).
2. When text is present: glyphs sit inside the field and are not clipped by the border.
3. When empty: field still shows empty chrome (not a solid missing rectangle).
4. FOCUSED: border or caret emphasis is visible vs unfocused (stronger border and/or caret).
5. DISABLED: field and text are visibly dimmed (muted border/ink) vs enabled — not full-strength.
6. FAIL if: no field chrome, text drawn outside the box, or disabled looks fully enabled.
